articles.title: Bitcoin crashes to 3-month low below $63,000 as analyst flags fourth capitulation wave
articles.summary: Bitcoin reached a three-month low as analysts warn that the market may be entering a fourth wave of capitulation.
articles.explain: Capitulation is a stage in market cycles where investors 'give up' and sell their assets en masse, usually out of fear that prices will drop even further. It is often seen as a final, intense wave of selling before a market potentially finds a floor.

articles.explain: Dividend yield is a financial ratio showing how much a company pays out in dividends each year relative to its stock price. A high yield can attract income-focused investors, though it is important to analyze why a company is paying out such large amounts.

story.title: High Dividend Stock Opportunities
story.so_far: Dividends are portions of a company's profit paid out to shareholders as a reward for their investment. Dividend yield is calculated by dividing the annual dividend per share by the stock's current price. It is a common metric for income-focused investors looking to generate cash flow from their portfolio.

articles.title: Kazakhstan plans tokenized government bonds in first quarter after $22 million note sale
articles.summary: Kazakhstan intends to issue tokenized government bonds in the first quarter of 2026 following a successful pilot sale.
articles.explain: Tokenization involves turning real-world assets into digital tokens that live on a blockchain. By using this technology for government bonds, countries hope to modernize their debt markets and make them more accessible to digital-native investors.

story.title: Tokenized Government Debt
story.so_far: Tokenized government bonds represent traditional debt instruments recorded on a blockchain. This process aims to increase transparency, lower administrative costs, and allow for faster settlement of financial transactions compared to traditional banking systems.

timeline.text: Kazakhstan plans to scale its tokenized bond program in Q1 2026 after a $22 million successful note sale.
